title: Command envelope v1
description: A command queued by central for one site. The site id must match the mTLS certificate; it is never trusted from the request body. Remediation commands carry only a catalogue action id and typed parameters. Diagnostic commands name a read-only tool. No shell, kubectl passthrough or arbitrary code field exists.

command_id.description: Command id. The site stores an execution record keyed by this id; a duplicate must return the recorded result and must not re-execute.

command_type.description: Command family. The payload shape is selected by this value.

site_id.description: Target site. Must equal the site id in the mTLS certificate; a mismatch is rejected and audited.

expires_at.description: Expiry time, UTC RFC 3339. Must be after issued_at; the default policy expiry is 300 seconds. Expired commands are rejected with 410 and audited.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key for the dispatch attempt. The local execution record is keyed by command_id.

payload.description: Command body, selected by command_type. See the conditional rules below.

action_id.description: Catalogue action id. Anything outside contracts/actions/actions.yaml is L3 and must never be dispatched.

action_version.description: Catalogue action version, so a changed action definition cannot silently alter a queued command.

target.description: Exact target. The resource UID is re-checked at the site; a name alone is not enough.

parameters.description: Typed parameters for the action. ACT-001/ACT-003 take no parameters; ACT-002 requires replicas (see the action-specific rules below).

policy_version.description: Policy snapshot version used for the decision. The site re-checks it against its cached snapshot.

approval_id.description: Approval reference for L2 actions. Null is allowed for L1 actions; ACT-003 is always L2 and therefore requires a non-null approval.

tool.description: Read-only diagnostic tool. search_runbooks is P1; the rest are available from S7 onward.

arguments.description: Typed tool arguments. Validated outside the LLM before dispatch; invalid arguments are rejected before reaching the site.

max_bytes.description: Optional response cap. Defaults to the gateway/tool cap when omitted; never larger than 64 KiB.

replicas.description: Desired replica count. The site policy additionally enforces min_replicas and max_replicas; scale-in and changes larger than +1 are L2.

parameters.description: ACT-001 (restart) and ACT-003 (rollback) take no parameters.

approval_id.description: ACT-003 is always L2; a null or missing approval is invalid.
